event.name: Prompt to Production: AI Builders, Secure Code and Skills Workshop
event.description:
Learn how to take an idea from a simple prompt to a working application using AI. This hands-on workshop covers the complete AI development process — building applications, securing AI-generated code, and publishing reusable AI skills.

You will use AI tools to create an application, test and improve its security, and turn parts of your project into tools that other AI agents can use.

You will build an application from a single prompt using AI, learn how AI can plan, code, test, and improve projects, identify and fix security issues in AI-generated code, publish your work as reusable AI Skills, explore how modern AI workflows are changing software development.

Perfect for developers, builders, and anyone interested in creating applications with AI.
event.location: Homebrew Club, 111 Maiden Ln #540, San Francisco, CA 94108

sponsors.companyDescription: ​AutonomLayer is an autonomous AI software engineering platform that goes beyond traditional AI coding assistants. Instead of requiring continuous prompting, it independently plans work, generates and refines prompts, writes code, tests, debugs, reviews, and iterates until an application is production-ready.

​Snyk helps developers build securely by automatically finding and fixing vulnerabilities in code, open-source dependencies, containers, and infrastructure. It's an essential part of modern software development, ensuring that AI-generated code is secure before it reaches production.

​FinChip helps turn AI skills into ownable digital assets that can be launched, discovered, used, and traded. For builders exploring agent capabilities, skill marketplaces, and programmable AI services, FinChip opens up a new way to think about software as something agents can own and invoke.
